lines.text: Many learners say: The life is beautiful.

native.tip: مع الأشياء العامة لا نضع the: “Life is beautiful.” وليس “The life is beautiful.”.

en.hook: Do you say “The life is beautiful”?
en.tip: With general things we do not use the: “Life is beautiful.” not “The life is beautiful.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “The life is beautiful.” 😅 With general things we do not use the, so the right sentence is “Life is beautiful.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
